acceptanceCriteria: One command runs a generated test live (js-live-test-provider/PWP) at a pinned revision, applies TSA validity, binds steps/selectors/methods (RVN extended), runs negative controls (NEA/BBF), and emits one acceptance receipt: PROVEN or the failing stage with evidence.
Qualified on one real adopter app with a recorded set of 'show me how' goals, reporting proven/abstained/failed counts.
Validity reuses CCE-V0-009 seeded-mutant discrimination, RVN receipts and the TSA JS hygiene checks from V1-1858 (JS-NO-ASSERTION, JS-CONSTANT-EXPECTATION, JS-SUBJECT-MOCKED) on the generated spec.
body: Owner goal (2026-10-19): from an app's existing tests, learn every page object, link/navigation, data setup and the step sequences that do anything in the site; then 'show me how to do X' builds an e2e test that demonstrates X, proven by a live run, or abstains naming what is missing. Inventory at origin/main 6ceee260b: appmap screens/page-object bindings (AMAP-V0), navigation ledger (ANL-V0), flows (AFU-V1), legacy discovery/crosswalk (DCP-V1-060..069), test-knowledge (DCP-V1-086..092, PR #1165), AMSP draft planner, CCE compile/prove (partly unbuilt), NEA/RVN/PWP/TSA validation pieces exist but are not chained. NEA, RVN, PWP/js-live, TSA and BBF exist separately and are not chained.
title: Site knowledge 8: one proof pipeline for generated tests - live run, TSA validity, step binding, negative controls, acceptance receipt
